_metadata.description: Expected QoI values for AortaCFD benchmark cases. Single source of truth for tests/benchmarks/.
_metadata.source: Wang et al. Table 3 (BPM120 production). Tutorial-coarse values from 2026-04-09 reference run on /media/Elements1.
_metadata.verified_2026_05_13: BPM120 production mesh-cell expectation lowered from 1.7-2.1M to 240-330K — the current v1.2.x config produces ~246K cells (legacy_surface) or ~317K (adaptive_span, span=16); the paper's '1.9M' setting is not reproducible with current code. See benchmarks/README.md mesh-cell note.

production_standard._comment: Wang et al. Table 3 reference. Cell-count range reflects what current code actually produces (246K legacy / 317K adaptive_span); paper's 1.9M unverified on this codebase.

osi_mean_masked._comment: value pending; placeholder for tolerance shape

production_robust._comment: First-order schemes give a sharper resolved coarctation peak → ~27% higher TAWSS p99 than standard. Pressure drop ~4% lower. Per Wang et al. Table 3 scheme-sensitivity.

production_precise._comment: LUST + CrankNicolson; closest to standard but slightly different TAWSS due to lower numerical diffusion. Per Wang et al. Table 3.

tutorial_coarse._reference_run: output/BPM120/run_20260409_195511 (on /media/Elements1 backup, 109,597 cells, 1 cycle = 0.5s, wall ~1h46m on 8 cores). QoIs extracted via v1.2.0 --postprocess.
tutorial_coarse._use: Live-solver benchmark validation for v1.2.0. Full production benchmark (Wang et al. Table 3) deferred to v1.2.1 (requires ~10-25 h HPC run).

0014_H_AO_COA._status: TODO — pediatric coarctation case (SimVascular VMR), tracked since v1.2.1. Populate with LES+robust profile reference run.

VOL04._status: TODO — adult aorta with MAPPED_PROFILE inlet. R4 of config matrix verified solver convergence (6h wall on 8 cores for t=0→0.05s); full benchmark values pending.
